newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs seen firm but rangebound after Thursday gains.
newsitem.headline: JGBs seen firm but rangebound after Thursday gains.

text.p: The key June 10-year Japanese government bond futures contract is expected to trade with a slight upward bias on Friday, but the upside is seen limited, traders said.
June may receive a follow-through boost from firmness in late Tokyo trade on Thursday and on LIFFE overnight, and may make a tentative try for 127.00, traders said.
"If June opens near its overnight LIFFE close, it may make a try for 127.00," a trader for a trust bank's securities unit said.
June closed at 126.77 on LIFFE overnight.
But June's upside is likely to be limited, as the market lacks any fresh buying incentives, traders said.

"Investors are reluctant to buy at the current high prices. JGBs will also have a hard time rising substantially ahead of a 10-year JGB auction next week," a trader for another trust bank's securities unit said.
Selling is likely to set in above 127.00 and cap the June contract's rise, the trader added.
